adjudication.rationale: Real issue: in packages/core/EventManager.ts the code was updated to treat calendar references as an array (using `.filter(...)` and looping over all `_calendar` references), but the merge-cleanup block still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`. With multiple calendar references per booking, `find` returns only the first match, so only one old calendar event would be deleted during a merge/reschedule, leaving other old host calendar events orphaned.
